ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Read Figure 1-2 and Figure 1-3. <image1> Classified by origin, in Figure 1-3, which label is the same as the rock type formed by the volcanic eruption at the summit of Mount Fuji in Japan?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: on the left of the figure is the landscape photograph of the Danxia Mountain landform in Figure 1-2; on the right is the schematic diagram of lithosphere material circulation in Figure 1-3. In Figure 1-3 there are four labels: Yi is at the upper left, Bing is at the lower left, Jia is at the upper right, and Ding is at the lower right. In the figure, the arrow pointing upward from Ding to Jia is labeled “condensation.” Then reason: the rock formed by volcanic eruption at the summit of Mount Fuji in Japan, classified by origin, belongs to volcanic eruptive rock, that is, igneous rock formed after magma erupts and then cools and solidifies. In Figure 1-3, the product of “condensation” corresponds to from Ding to Jia, so the label with the same rock type as it is Jia.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图1-3是岩石圈物质循环示意图，标注甲位于右上，丁位于右下，二者之间有由丁指向甲的“冷凝作用”箭头。再读题干：日本富士山顶火山喷发形成的岩石按成因属于火山喷发岩，即岩浆冷却凝固形成的岩浆岩。把这一成因与图中“冷凝作用”的产物对应，可知图1-3中该岩石类型对应标注甲。
